title: FlowDoc Product Terminology Foundation
summary: Define a bounded product terminology foundation before Editor/frontend redesign work so future agents resolve overloaded FlowDoc terms through Project Control instead of guessing across Core, Backend, and Editor contexts.
expectedOutput: A canonical product terminology glossary, Thai companion, FlowDoc guidance update, and Project Control records that make terminology discipline part of future product and frontend rounds without changing product behavior.
riskSummary: Terminology can reduce ambiguity but cannot prove product behavior, readiness, compatibility, or repository truth. Missing product-specific terms must remain UNKNOWN, RISK, or BLOCKER until the owning repository and evidence are clear.
